$comment: v2 recut 2026-08-23 — hero retargeted from the transcript to the sidebar + composer. The transcript is texture, never the subject.

project.objective: In 14 silent seconds: press a key, a new agent thread is born, and you watch it take its place in the sidebar.
project.audience: Developers already running multiple coding agents who are tired of switching windows.
project.placement: ghostties.org v3 hero. Plays once on load, then rests on frame 01. Replay on hover or click. Never loops — the ambient ghost field owns continuous motion.
subjectRules: The SIDEBAR is the subject. It opens the film and it closes it.
The COMPOSER is the verb — the thing being done, keyboard-first.
The TRANSCRIPT is texture. It must be alive and never ask to be read. No beat centres on it, no zoom targets it.

source.instance: dedicated build launched by the capture rig — never the daily driver

display.note: maxSharpZoom = capturePixels.width / (heroWidthCss * 2). The recut's ceiling dropped from 1.45 to 1.35 — the composer is a large centred panel and does not need as much push as a 232pt sidebar did.

visualConstraints: Fabricated sessions only. No real project names, paths, branches, or transcript content.
Window-scoped capture. The desktop must never appear in frame.
The take must be FULLY keyboard-doable — Cmd-T, type, arrow, Return. If any step needs the mouse, it is not filmed and it is not claimed.
Light and dark are two takes of an identical script — same timings, same keystrokes.

camera.units: zoom is a scale factor on the capture frame; pan is the top-left offset in capture pixels at that zoom
camera.attentionTreatment: Outside the focus region, luminance drops 18% over 400ms. Never a hard vignette edge.

scenes.purpose: Many agents, one window. The sidebar is introduced as the thing to watch.
scenes.appPrecondition: Sessions tab. ACTIVE 5. Transcript mid-stream on the right as texture.
scenes.expectedUiState: Five rows, five ghost glyphs, mixed status colours.
scenes.verification: Five rows legible at 1140px. No pointer visible.

scenes.purpose: The verb. One keystroke opens the way to a new agent thread.
scenes.action: Press Cmd-T. The composer overlay opens.
scenes.expectedUiState: Composer panel centred over the window. Query field focused, empty.
scenes.cursor: never enters frame — this beat is keyboard only
scenes.transition: push in, timed so the camera settles as the panel finishes opening
scenes.verification: The panel's open animation and the camera push resolve within 100ms of each other.
scenes.captureStatus: NEEDS CAPTURE — no committed still shows the composer

scenes.purpose: Keyboard-first, made visible. This is the part people will try to copy.
scenes.action: Type a few characters. Breadcrumb chips resolve project and template. Arrow to a result.
scenes.expectedUiState: Chips populate as the query narrows. Result list reorders. No mouse touches a chip.
scenes.transition: camera holds — the motion in this beat is the typing, not the lens
scenes.verification: Every keystroke in the take is reproducible by keyboard alone. If a chip needed a click, the beat is reshot.

scenes.purpose: The payoff: a new ghost takes its place in the sidebar because you put it there.
scenes.action: Press Return. The composer dismisses and a new session row animates into the sidebar.
scenes.expectedUiState: Panel dismisses. A sixth row appears in ACTIVE with its own ghost.
scenes.transition: pull back and left — the camera arrives on the sidebar as the row lands
scenes.verification: The new row is fully in frame before its entrance animation starts, never during the camera move.

scenes.purpose: Rest position. The new ghost picks up its colour and the page hands the motion back to the drifting field.
scenes.action: The new session's glyph turns from idle to working.
scenes.expectedUiState: Identical framing to scene 01, now with six rows.
scenes.verification: Final framing matches scene 01 exactly, so the rest state is seamless.

openQuestions: Beat 05's idle->working flip may happen naturally when a session starts. If it does not, it is the only beat still needing fixture help — everything else in this recut is user-driven.
The composer's Cmd-T binding was not located in SessionComposerOverlay.swift; confirm the actual trigger before the take.

derivedOutputs.demoVideo: hero-{theme}.mp4 — H.265 plus AV1, poster frame from scene 01, preload none
